html:
G'oya

Avval har bir bo'limning o'rtacha maoshini hisoblaymiz. Bu kichik natijani xodimlarga department_id bo'yicha ulasak, har bir xodim qatorida o'z bo'limining o'rtachasi paydo bo'ladi va ularni oddiy WHERE bilan solishtirish mumkin.

Yechim

SELECT d.name AS department, e.name, e.salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id
JOIN (
  SELECT department_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary
  FROM employees
  GROUP BY department_id
) a ON a.department_id = e.department_id
WHERE e.salary > a.avg_salary

Namunada IT'ning o'rtachasi 8000, undan faqat Aziz (9000) yuqori. Moliyada o'rtacha 5000, Dilnoza 6000 oladi. HR'da yolg'iz Farrux, u o'rtachaning o'zi va chiqmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Kompaniya o'rtachasi bilan solishtirish. Namunada u 6500: IT'ning uchala xodimi ham undan yuqori, Moliyadagi Dilnoza esa past.

Noto'g'riSELECT d.name AS department, e.name, e.salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id
WHERE e.salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)

>= yozilsa, o'rtachaga teng maosh ham kiradi: namunada IT'dagi Charos (8000) va HR'dagi Farrux.

O'rtachani yaxlitlash ham xato. Bo'limda 10, 11 va 11 maosh bo'lsa, o'rtacha 10.67. ROUND uni 11 qiladi va 11 oladigan ikki xodim natijadan tushib qoladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT d.name AS department, e.name, e.salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id
JOIN (
  SELECT department_id, ROUND(AVG(salary)) AS avg_salary
  FROM employees
  GROUP BY department_id
) a ON a.department_id = e.department_id
WHERE e.salary > a.avg_salary

SUM(salary) / COUNT(*) esa bu yerda zarar qilmaydi, garchi butun bo'lish kasrni tashlasa ham. Maosh butun son: 10.67 dan katta butun son 10 dan ham katta, natija o'zgarmaydi.
